description: This file defines an abstract class `ModelWidgetCondition` and various inner classes representing different types of conditions (e.g., logical operators, comparisons, permission checks, regex matches) used in a widget modeling framework. It appears to parse and evaluate XML-based condition definitions for widget rendering logic in Apache OFBiz.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition
classes.description: Abstract base class for widget condition models, providing evaluation logic and nested static classes for specific condition types such as logical operators, comparisons, permission checks, regex matches, etc.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.And
classes.description: Represents a logical AND of multiple sub-conditions.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.ConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating condition instances from XML elements.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.DefaultConditionFactory
classes.description: Default implementation of the ConditionFactory, supporting various condition types based on XML node names.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.IfCompare
classes.description: Represents an <if-compare> condition, performing comparisons between widget fields and specified values.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.IfCompareField
classes.description: Represents an <if-compare-field> condition, comparing values between two fields.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.IfEmpty
classes.description: Checks if a specified field is empty.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.IfEntityPermission
classes.description: Checks entity permissions via permission checker.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.IfHasPermission
classes.description: Checks if the current user has a specific permission or action permission.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.IfRegexp
classes.description: Performs a regular expression match on a field's value.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.IfServicePermission
classes.description: Checks permissions for a specific service invocation.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.IfValidateMethod
classes.description: Invokes a static validation method on a specified class.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.Not
classes.description: Represents a logical NOT of a sub-condition.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.Or
classes.description: Represents a logical OR of multiple sub-conditions.

classes.name: ModelWidgetCondition.Xor
classes.description: Represents a logical XOR of multiple sub-conditions.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition based on the provided context map.

methods.name: readSubConditions
methods.description: Reads and constructs a list of sub-conditions from an XML element.
